licenseNotes: Original composition for LifePatch — 'The Debtor's March'. Generic tonal voicings in D minor (i - bVImaj7 - iv - V - i - III - bVII - V7); no existing song, beat, melody, riff, drop or arrangement was referenced or transcribed. Papers, Please and Undertale were mood and instrumentation references only. No sampled or third-party material — every voice is synthesized live in Tone.js.
sourceNotes: Procedural; phases `menu` and `gameplay` of src/audio/AudioEngine.ts, built from src/audio/score.ts. Same 16-bar cycle as score-intro and score-recap — this is ONE piece heard at different mixes, which is why every screen change is a gain crossfade and never a cut. 108 BPM: beat 555.556ms, 8th 277.778ms, bar 2222.222ms; 44100 x 60 / 108 = 24,500 samples per beat exactly, so the loop is sample-aligned. MENU is the anthem heard from the filing room next door: lead 0.21, keys forward at 0.64, snare/ticks pulled back to 0.17 so nobody is being marched at while reading UI copy. GAMEPLAY drops the tune entirely (lead 0) — it would compete with the player's own arithmetic — and lets INTENSITY_RULES.gameplay bring the room in as financial stress rises: bass = 0.37 + i*0.11, keys = 0.71 - i*0.14 (the comp gets out of the way), snare = 0.17 + i*0.42, ticks = 0.14 + i*0.35, tension = max(0, (i - 0.45) * 0.99) — the economy's minor-2nd grind (D2+Eb2) stays silent until things actually warrant it, which is why intensityLayers has a threshold at level 1 rather than a permanent low-level whine. Nothing new is introduced at high intensity; it is the same material leaning harder. The intensity value itself is unchanged from the previous score: clamp(0.30 + debtPressure + lowHealth + lowMood + macroTension, 0, 1), where debtPressure is up to +0.25 as debt rises vs cash, lowHealth/lowMood up to +0.15 each, and macroTension +0.3 in a bad/warning macro year. WIRED: components/run/ConsequenceBeat.tsx (clock in components/run/useConsequenceLadder.ts) snaps its ceremony ladder onto this grid via hooks/useBeatClock — stamp on the ceremony's downbeat, count-up spanning a whole number of beats (the gap between two snapped boundaries), impact landing ON the beat with the `consequence` + stampGood/stampBad stingers requested ACCENT_PREROLL_MS (120ms) early so the engine's 8th-note quantization resolves them onto that same instant. An 80ms HITSTOP separates the impact from its follow-through. Minor-tier beats ride the 8th grid instead (a whole-beat lock would stretch them ~40%). The count-up tick is transposed by juiceTier().pitch (a filter shift on band-limited noise — no note is added to the score). Muted and not-yet-unlocked players get the identical ladder on a local performance.now() grid at the same tempo. See .claude/audio/qc/cue-plan.md and .claude/audio/qc/consequence-cue.json.
